name: ExcusesForNonConformance
title: Excuses for Non-Conformance
publisher: The Committee for Doing It Properly
description: Reasons offered when a system does not do what the specification says. The full code system is believed to be infinite; this resource is a fragment containing the most frequently observed members.

concept.definition: The feature is on the roadmap, which is a document that moves.
The SHALL was interpreted in light of the surrounding context, which was a deadline.

concept.display: No customer has asked for it
concept.definition: Customers have asked, but not in the correct ticketing system.
The machine in question is not available for inspection.
The specification is ambiguous in a way that happens to match the existing implementation.
